note: Claude's next upgrade ideas, shown in the app (🤖 Claude > 💡 Ideas, or ask the chat "give me ideas"). 👍 Do it turns one into a request. Claude keeps this list fresh: take out what was built, add new ones. Plain words, no tenant data.

ideas.title: The helper asks how it went
ideas.why: After a job it asks "How did it go at 90th Street?" and keeps your answer as the job's note.

ideas.title: Dressed for the weather
ideas.why: A coat and hat in the cold, a raincoat in the rain, short sleeves in the heat.

ideas.title: A whole day hands-free
ideas.why: From "start my day" to the last package, the helper leads every step by voice while you drive and work.

ideas.title: Your papers in one place
ideas.why: Insurance, license and certificates with their dates; the helper warns you 30 days before one runs out.

ideas.title: A whole day hands-free
ideas.why: From "start my day" to the last package: the robot leads every step by voice while you drive and work.

ideas.title: The robot starts talking right away
ideas.why: It says the first sentence while the rest of the answer is still coming, like a person, so you don't wait in silence.

ideas.title: Friday score from the robot
ideas.why: Friday afternoon the robot gives you the week: bids sent, jobs finished, jobs won, money in, with a trophy for a good week.

ideas.title: Store stop on the way
ideas.why: When today's list needs materials, the robot adds the closest Home Depot or supply store on your route.

ideas.title: The robot says what it sees
ideas.why: Take a before photo and the robot names the problem (leak stain, mold, broken plaster) and adds it to the job notes.

ideas.title: HPD emails in 20 seconds
ideas.why: When you open the app, the robot sums up new HPD emails out loud: who wrote, which job, what they want.

ideas.title: Traffic colors on the route
ideas.why: The route line on the map turns red where traffic is slow, so you know before you leave.

ideas.title: Say the price, the bid fills itself
ideas.why: On a bid say "2,400" and the price goes on page 1, page 2 and the work form at once.

ideas.title: Tenants confirm with one tap
ideas.why: The tenant gets a link: tap Yes / Change time. The map shows confirmed in green by itself.

ideas.title: Why you lost a bid
ideas.why: For each bid you lost, the winning price next to yours, so the next price is right.

ideas.title: Today's money
ideas.why: At the top: money earned today and this week from finished jobs, counting up as you finish.

ideas.title: Open in one second
ideas.why: The app shows the last screen right away and fills in new numbers after, instead of "Loading jobs".

ideas.title: A cleaner screen
ideas.why: Hide the buttons you never use; the map gets more room and the robot stands out.

ideas.title: Notice answers written for you
ideas.why: When a 24/72-hour notice comes in, the answer is already written with the dates; you check it and tap twice to send.

ideas.title: Send a job to your worker
ideas.why: One tap texts a worker the address, the work and the photos needed.

ideas.title: Tenant texts in Spanish
ideas.why: When the tenant writes in Spanish, the app shows it in English and writes your answer in Spanish.

ideas.title: Morning plan in 20 seconds
ideas.why: At 7 AM the chat says today's jobs in the best order, bids due, notices and the weather, out loud, with one tap to start the route.

ideas.title: The chat asks the next step
ideas.why: After every answer it offers the next useful thing, like "Text the tenant?" or "Open the affidavit?", so you finish each job in a few taps.

ideas.title: See Claude's change before you try it
ideas.why: When Claude finishes a request it puts a picture of the new screen in Your requests, so you see what changed at a glance.

ideas.title: Price coach on every bid
ideas.why: Next to the price box: the prices that won this kind of job in the last 6 months, and how likely your price is to win.

ideas.title: Which bids you win
ideas.why: Your win rate by borough and type of work, and the prices that won, so you know where to bid lower or higher.

ideas.title: One-hand mode
ideas.why: A switch that moves the main buttons to the bottom corner so you can reach everything with your thumb while holding tools.

ideas.title: Notes on every job
ideas.why: Type or say a note on a job card (like gate code or who to ask for). It shows up next time you open that job.

ideas.title: Money coming in
ideas.why: One screen with invoices sent, paid and still waiting, with the oldest unpaid first.

ideas.title: Photos work with no signal
ideas.why: Take before and after photos in a basement with no signal; they send by themselves when you are back online.

ideas.title: Chat notes show on the job card
ideas.why: What you told the chat to remember about an address also shows on that job's card, so you see it before you knock.

ideas.title: Tap to call the super
ideas.why: On a job card, one tap calls or texts the contact you saved for that address.

ideas.title: Send tomorrow's route
ideas.why: One tap sends tomorrow's route (addresses only) to your own phone or a helper's.

ideas.title: Photo checklist per job
ideas.why: Each job shows the photos HPD needs (before, after, close-up) with ticks as you take them.

ideas.title: Insurance and license dates
ideas.why: The app warns you 30 days before an insurance or license paper runs out.

ideas.title: Bids with no price yet
ideas.why: A small count on the Bids button of invitations still waiting for your price.

ideas.title: Rain check on the route
ideas.why: If rain or snow is coming, the route plan puts indoor jobs first and warns you about outdoor ones.

ideas.title: Say a note after each job
ideas.why: Tap the mic on a finished job and say what you did; the app writes it down on that job.

ideas.title: Rejected job fixer
ideas.why: When HPD rejects a job, the app lists exactly what to redo and puts it first on tomorrow's route.

ideas.title: Month at a glance
ideas.why: One card with jobs done, invoices paid and money still waiting this month.

ideas.title: Dark screen at night
ideas.why: A switch for a dark screen that is easier on the eyes in a dark truck.

ideas.title: Bigger buttons with gloves on
ideas.why: A switch that makes every button bigger so you can tap it with work gloves.

ideas.title: Invoice already filled in
ideas.why: When the affidavit is approved, the invoice opens with the job, the amount and the OMO already filled, so you only check it and send.

ideas.title: All jobs with paperwork left
ideas.why: One list on the home screen of every finished job that still has photos, an affidavit or an invoice missing, oldest first.

ideas.title: Building history
ideas.why: Every past job at this address with its photos and notes, one tap from the job card.

ideas.title: Week view
ideas.why: Jobs, appointments, bids due and notices for the next 7 days on one screen.

ideas.title: Invoice check before sending
ideas.why: Before the invoice goes out, the app checks the amount matches the award and the COA, and says what doesn't.

ideas.title: How long each kind of work takes
ideas.why: The robot tells you, from your timed jobs, how long doors, plaster or locks usually take, so you can plan the day and price bids.

ideas.title: Job is taking long
ideas.why: If you are on a job much longer than your usual time, the robot asks if you want to text the next tenant that you are running late.

ideas.title: Say why there is no photo
ideas.why: When the robot warns about a missing after photo, one tap saves a reason (no access, tenant refused) on the job.

ideas.title: Did you bring everything?
ideas.why: Before you leave the office, the robot reads the shopping list for today's jobs and asks if the truck has it all.
